[[File:Pod_17_The_Spike.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Spike's Pod Seventeen]]
'''Pod Seventeen''' was a factory compartment of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s space station [[The Spike (space station)|The Spike]] during the [[Second Charge Matrica]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. This factory was used to build [[kinetic corruptor]]s, large machines that were used to extract [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] and which were capable of generating large explosions. A [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] overseer was in charge of the station and the [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] [[GAD-3]] also worked there. During the [[Raid on The Spike]], parts of the factory were damaged during a duel between Odion and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]].
